title: SEO Agency Birmingham: Google and AI Search | 22 Signals
description: SEO and GEO for Birmingham businesses: rank in Google, win the local map pack and show up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and AI Overview answers. Monthly reports.
h1: SEO agency Birmingham firms use to win Google and AI answers
intro: We run SEO and GEO for established Birmingham businesses: technical fixes, local SEO and Google Business Profile, content that answers buyer questions, and the outside mentions that make search engines and AI assistants trust you. The aim is simple: rank for the searches that bring work, and show up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers when buyers ask for recommendations.

p: A buyer looking for a precision machining supplier, a commercial property solicitor or an aesthetics clinic in Birmingham no longer just types a query and clicks the first result. They might ask ChatGPT for a shortlist, read a Google AI Overview, check the map pack, then visit two websites before calling one. If your business is missing at any of those steps, a competitor fills the gap.

That is why we treat classic SEO and GEO, or generative engine optimisation, as one job. Both depend on the same things: a fast, clear site, pages that answer real questions, and consistent, credible information about your business across the web.

sections.h: What our SEO and GEO work includes
list: Technical SEO: speed, crawling, indexing, structured data and fixing what holds the site back.
Local SEO and Google Business Profile: categories, services, photos, reviews process and consistent details across directories.
Content: service, location and question pages written for buyers, checked for accuracy before they go live.
How your business is described across the web: directories, industry bodies, partner sites and profiles, all saying the same thing.
Answer-first pages that AI assistants can quote directly.
Outside mentions: trade press, local business media and industry sites.
Monthly reporting: rankings, enquiries and how often you appear in AI answers for the questions that matter.

Manufacturers and automotive suppliers in the West Midlands: technical, long-tail searches such as specific processes, materials and tolerances, which have low volume but come from buyers with real projects.
Law and accountancy firms in the Colmore Business District: practice-area pages that rank, comply with SRA and professional body rules, and answer the questions clients ask before they call.
Clinics in the Edgbaston Medical Quarter and beyond: treatment pages and local SEO, written within the advertising rules that apply to medical and aesthetic claims.
Logistics and distribution firms: service and coverage pages for the searches procurement teams run.
Retailers and Jewellery Quarter businesses: product and category SEO, local searches for engagement rings, repairs and bespoke pieces, and Google Business Profile done properly.

sections.h: Local search across the city and region
p: Birmingham is a big, spread-out city with strong local identities. Many people search by area, such as Solihull, Sutton Coldfield, Edgbaston, Harborne or Moseley, rather than for Birmingham as a whole, and businesses with several sites need each location set up properly. We build location pages only where you genuinely serve or have premises, set up each Google Business Profile, and keep names, addresses and phone numbers identical everywhere.

Reviews matter here too. We set up a simple process for asking happy customers for Google reviews and replying to every one, which helps the map pack and gives AI assistants more to go on. We never buy or write reviews.
The city also searches in more than one language. Where your customers look for services in Urdu as well as English, we can write and optimise content in both.

sections.h: How we work: Talk, Plan, Build, Grow
list: Talk: we learn which services and areas bring the best work, and where enquiries come from today.
Plan: an audit and a written plan with priority pages, technical fixes and every date in writing.
Build: fixes and new content go live in planned batches, each one checked.
Grow: monthly reporting, new content, outside mentions and ongoing fixes.

p: Right now, 10 of the businesses we work with sit in Google's top five for their main searches and show up in ChatGPT's answers. The same method suits the professional, healthcare and industrial firms that make up much of Birmingham's economy: clear pages, checked facts and steady outside mentions.

For a US aesthetics practice, we ran a 35-question audit across five AI engines to see exactly when and how the practice appeared in answers. We use the same method for Birmingham clients: write the questions your buyers ask, run them through the main AI assistants and Google, record who gets mentioned, and fix the gaps on your site and across the web.

sections.h: Working with an SEO agency Birmingham is 80 minutes from
p: We run SEO for Birmingham businesses from our London head office. We do not have a Birmingham office or staff in the city. SEO is a remote discipline anyway: access to your site, analytics and Search Console, a shared plan, and a monthly report and call in the same time zone. When a project needs it, for example a content day to interview your experts or photograph your premises, we come to Birmingham.

We do not publish prices, and an SEO agency Birmingham firms hire should price from a scope, not a package. Cost depends on the size and state of your site, how many services and locations you want to rank for, how competitive those searches are, how much content is needed, and whether you need outside mentions built. Related services: web development, paid media and video in Birmingham, so search, ads and content can work together under one Signal Lead.

faqs.q: What does an SEO agency Birmingham businesses hire actually do each month?
faqs.a: With us: technical fixes, new and improved pages, Google Business Profile work, building consistent mentions of your business across the web, and checking how you appear in AI answers. You get a monthly report showing rankings, enquiries and progress against the written plan.

faqs.q: What is GEO, and do Birmingham businesses need it?
faqs.a: GEO means making your business easy for AI assistants to understand and recommend. If your buyers use ChatGPT, Gemini or Google AI Overviews to shortlist suppliers, firms or clinics, it matters. Most of the work overlaps with good SEO: clear pages, accurate facts and credible outside mentions.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take to work?
faqs.a: Technical fixes and Google Business Profile changes can show results within weeks. Competitive service rankings usually take months, depending on your site's history and the competition. We set out what to expect in the plan and report honestly on progress every month.

faqs.q: Can you help a manufacturer that wins work through referrals?
faqs.a: Yes. Many manufacturers we speak to rank for little beyond their own name. Pages built around your processes, materials, sectors and accreditations attract buyers with real projects. The volume is low, but each enquiry tends to be valuable and well qualified.

faqs.q: Do you meet Birmingham clients in person?
faqs.a: When the project needs it, for example to interview your experts for content or photograph your premises. Day-to-day SEO runs remotely from our London head office, with a monthly report and call in the same time zone.

faqs.q: Can you do SEO for several Birmingham locations?
faqs.a: Yes. We set up and manage a Google Business Profile for each genuine location, build location pages where you actually operate, and keep details consistent across directories. We do not build pages for areas you do not serve, because search engines treat those as spam.

faqs.q: Can you write SEO content in Urdu as well as English?
faqs.a: Yes. Where your Birmingham customers search in Urdu, for example for clinics, legal services or retail, we can write and optimise pages in Urdu alongside English, with proper language tags so Google shows the right version. We only recommend it where the search demand is really there.
